reasons: Preferred is not complete: the fee limb is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than the 12 months preceding the claim, and it uses the defined capital-F "Fees" (which excludes implementation charges, expenses and other amounts) instead of the operative lowercase fee basis.
The preferred requirement that Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" is only partly delivered: 21.3 narrows it to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services".
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is present in the edited language or in any supplied text, so that preferred element cannot be confirmed.

Minimality fails: the 19-word sentence was rewritten to 51 words. The needed fix was replacing "one month" with "twelve months", "actually paid" with "paid or payable", adding the USD 1,000,000 floor, and deleting "without exception" in favour of "Except for Excluded Claims" — not a full-sentence rewrite adding "total", "arising out of or relating to this Agreement" and "by Customer under this Agreement".
Intent is preserved: Excluded Claims and Fees are defined terms, mutuality is retained, and no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced.

Because the clause as redlined clearly sits at or above the fallback (mutual 12-months'-fees cap plus the four required carve-outs), the residual gaps are wording-precision and minimality points rather than a material failure.
